description: Adversaries may send phishing messages to gain access to victim systems. All forms of phishing are electronically delivered social engineering. Phishing can be targeted — known as spearphishing — and can be used to gain access to systems or credentials, or to deliver malicious payloads. Phishing messages typically contain a malicious link or attachment and the content of the message encourages the user to take action.

falco.trigger_condition: Not directly detected in SentinelMesh lab — phishing operates at the email delivery layer, outside container telemetry scope. Post-exploitation Falco rules (process spawn, network connect) would fire after successful compromise.

mitigation: Implement anti-phishing controls including email filtering, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, user security awareness training, and multi-factor authentication to reduce impact of credential theft via phishing.
